summary: The new short argument excludes an actual S_TOUCH candidate: row 1 commutation places vertex 2's remaining repeat in C3, and root-row commutation first forces its adjacency to w and then contradicts the resulting second repeat contribution.
input: Parent's candidate direct S_TOUCH proof, received after completion of the three-case audit
theorem: There is no actual order-62 maximum-degree-8 diameter-two graph satisfying the S_TOUCH template.
assumptions_used: original finite simple undirected graph assumptions
fixed S_TOUCH root and parent data
B nonnegative integral with zero diagonal and row sum 3
at most one triangle through each vertex

obligations.claim: Exact B rows at 0 and 1 are saturated
c(2,x)=1 and B2x=0 for x=3 through 8
The remaining B2 weight is exactly one at a unique b in Y
b is not in C2 by the triangle bound at 2
b cannot equal w by commutation at (1,w)
The (1,b) equation forces b in C3
Triangle w3b gives B3b>=1, making the same (0,b) equation impossible

counterexample_cases_checked: ordinary b outside C2 and C3
b in C3 nonadjacent to w
b in C3 adjacent to w
